liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Touch Of Grey** (2 reviews): Jerry jumped into the third verse before the bridge finished and then lost the lyrics, with the band following him; Jerry came in with the wrong verse, which the reviewer found funny, and the crowd cheered him on [17][25]
- **Man Smart (Woman Smarter)** (2 reviews): Women Are Smarter is called one of the best ever, alongside the 4/19/87 version; Women Are Smarter is hot, but Uncle John's Band is judged even hotter [20][25]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Jack Straw jam sounds like the band machine churning, ending with Phil's bass pops; a favorite version [18]
- **Big Railroad Blues** (1 review): Big Railroad Blues is strong, though Jerry and Bobby sound off elsewhere in the show [15]
- **Uncle John's Band** (1 review): Reviewer especially loves the Uncle John's Band and Baby Blue on this recording [21]
- **Space** (1 review): Reviewer notes that Spaces from summer tour onward were consistently strong, before the fall tour [20]
- **Black Peter** (1 review): Reviewer singles out Black Peter, along with Uncle John's Band, Baby Blue and Ship of Fools [26]
- **Goin' Down The Road Feeling Bad** (1 review): Going Down the Road and One More Saturday Night partly rescue the show, but not entirely [15]

## The recordings

- **gd1983-06-25.166976.senn441.sharpless.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): audience recording; 21 songs; 165 min [1]
- **gd83-06-25.aud.dodd.11802.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 21 songs; 148 min; rated 4/5 by 8 [7]. Said about its sound: The tape is not the best quality available [18]
- **gd1983-06-25.senn421.bethke.118900.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 161 min; rated 2/5 by 2 [12]. Said about its sound: Described as a very good recording [21]
- **gd1983-06-25.148003.2nd.set.fob.akg.d330bt.senn421.hecht.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 12 songs; 106 min [13]

## Around the show

- Reviewer was brought by a friend, Karen, and this was the first of about a dozen shows seen in a year [19]
- Reviewer saw about six shows on this tour and ranks this one and Harrisburg as the weakest [15]
- St. Paul was mellower and more laid back than the stomping Madison show the night before; Poplar Creek followed [18]
- Taper considers his the best of the three audience sources, a decent tape of an unremarkable show [22]
- Reviewer thinks this overlooked show is likely as good as other shows from the period that get more love [26]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1983-06-25.166976.senn441.sharpless.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Gordon Sharpless; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Gordon Sharpless' Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 441 mics > Sony D6M > Gordon's Sony D6M (Maxell UDXL-II) [1]. Also: Patches come from Kyle Holbrook's Beyer M201 source and Chris Hecht's AKG D330BT plus Sennheiser 421 blend, including 10:59 of Drums [1]
- **gd83-06-25.aud.dodd.11802.sbeok.shnf**: source: ACM>C>DAT>CDR [7]. Also: Recorded by a taper with Nak 300 microphones way up front, possibly not from the first deck; Drums were left off the B side of the tape, a common policy among tapers then [20][22]
- **gd1983-06-25.senn421.bethke.118900.flac16**: transferred by Justin Lee John Wenzel; source: Sennheisser 421s>Sony TCD5M>cassette>cassette, Recorded by the late George "Fingers" Bethke FOB in the sweet spot as always; first gen. cassettes>Nakamichi… [12]
- **gd1983-06-25.148003.2nd.set.fob.akg.d330bt.senn421.hecht.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Chris Hecht; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Chris Hecht's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; (2) AKG D330BT mics + (1) Sennheiser 421 > Mixer > Sony D5M [13]. Also: George Bethke's Sennheiser 421 source supplies crowd and the start of Women Are Smarter, plus 3:04 of Drums [13]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Bobbie Bestic Grateful Dead: [1983-06-25 St. Paul Civic Center, St. Paul, MN, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1983-06-25-st-paul-civic-center-st-paul-mn-usa/) [28]
